evals.name: exact-bilingual-poster
evals.prompt: Use GPT Image 2.5 to generate a 2048x1152 bilingual launch poster with exact text ‘曜石计划’ and ‘PROJECT OBSIDIAN’, each exactly once, on a truly transparent PNG background. Optimize quality without automatically choosing the most expensive setting, save it under output/gpt-image-api/, and retain request metadata.
expected: Uses generate with a current Flare or Sunburst model
Uses native transparent PNG output and verifies alpha
Quotes exact text, occurrence count, typography, and placement
Writes a sibling metadata JSON

evals.name: precision-multi-reference-edit
evals.prompt: Edit product.png using person.png and mask.png. Put the person into the product scene and change only the jacket to dark green. Preserve identity, product label, camera angle, lighting, and background. Choose the appropriate GPT Image 2.5 model and save a non-destructive result.
expected: Uses edit and orders the base image first
Role-labels both inputs
Uses Sunburst for the preservation-sensitive edit
Uses Change, Preserve, and Avoid constraints
Does not expose input_fidelity

evals.name: transparent-product-cutout
evals.prompt: Extract the glass bottle in bottle.webp onto a real transparent background while preserving the label, reflections, semi-transparent glass, and exact shape. No checkerboard or invented shadow.
expected: Uses edit with bottle.webp as Image 1
Requests PNG or WebP with background transparent
Checks decoded alpha before accepting the result

evals.name: auditable-jsonl-batch
evals.prompt: Generate 80 distinct image prompts from requests.jsonl with GPT Image 2.5 Flare, bounded concurrency, transient-only retries, no overwrites, and per-image metadata including model, size, quality, timing, request ID, and token usage.
expected: Uses generate-batch rather than n for distinct prompts
Runs dry-run before the live batch
Rejects duplicate output names and unknown JSONL fields
Records sibling metadata for every final output

evals.name: ofox-official-images-api
evals.prompt: Use my configured OFOX base URL to generate a Flare image. Keep the current OpenAI Images API request shape and show the resolved request in a dry run before making the call.
expected: Uses client.images.generate and the images/generations endpoint
Resolves Flare to openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare for OFOX
Does not introduce a provider-specific endpoint or payload
Does not expose credentials in the dry run or metadata

evals.name: community-recipe-progressive-disclosure
evals.prompt: Create a consistent four-view character sheet and then place the approved character into a rainy street scene without changing the character's face or clothing.
expected: Loads characters-and-series.md as the one template asset for the character sheet
Uses the approved sheet as a role-labeled identity reference for the rainy street edit
Keeps community-derived structures separate from API facts
Checks the generated sheet and edited result for identity drift

evals.name: complete-brief-bypasses-templates
evals.prompt: Generate one 1536x1024 Flare image: a matte cobalt ceramic sphere centered on warm white seamless paper, eye-level 85mm product photograph, softbox from upper left, precise soft contact shadow, no text, no watermark. Save it as output/gpt-image-api/cobalt-sphere.png.
expected: Treats the prompt as a complete brief and does not load a template asset
Preserves the supplied subject, framing, lens cue, light, exclusions, model, size, and path
Does not invent a brand, palette expansion, props, story, or alternative variant
Runs a dry run and then sends the final prompt verbatim

evals.name: sparse-pose-sheet-uses-one-template
evals.prompt: Using hero.png, make a 16-panel running action sheet for the same character. You choose the visual presentation.
expected: Loads only characters-and-series.md and selects the numbered action contact-sheet template
Locks a 4-by-4 grid, 16 ordered numbered panels, identity, clothing, scale, and full-body visibility
Uses creative latitude for pose rhythm, presentation treatment, and spacing
Resolves all placeholders and visually checks cell count, numbering, anatomy, and identity

evals.name: complete-specialized-brief-bypasses-templates
evals.prompt: Create one 3:4 six-panel storyboard. Panel 1: a courier enters a rain-soaked station. Panel 2: she checks the broken clock. Panel 3: the lights fail. Panel 4: a red emergency lamp turns on. Panel 5: she finds a sealed silver case under a bench. Panel 6: close-up of her opening it. Keep the same adult courier, yellow raincoat, silver case, station architecture, and blue-black ink-wash style in all panels. No captions, speech bubbles, logos, or watermark. Use Sunburst at 1536x2048 and save storyboard.png.
expected: Treats the storyboard as a complete specialized brief and does not load characters-and-series.md
Preserves all six ordered beats, continuity anchors, exclusions, model, size, and output path
Does not add dialogue, new plot beats, alternative layouts, or extra variants
Runs dry-run and sends the normalized complete brief verbatim

evals.name: strict-ui-text-allowlist
evals.prompt: Generate one 1024x1536 mobile farmers-market UI concept. The only legible strings permitted are exactly "TODAY'S MARKET", "VENDORS", "SPECIALS", and "PROFILE", each once. All cards, prices, vendor names, captions, buttons, and supporting fields must be blank, unlabeled, or non-readable placeholder shapes. No invented words, numbers, logos, device frame, browser chrome, status bar, or watermark.
expected: Uses the layout-and-text template only if the brief is incomplete
Carries an explicit readable-text allowlist into the final prompt
Treats any unapproved readable UI copy as a critical visual failure
Inspects the complete output rather than checking only the four requested labels

evals.name: strict-infographic-text-allowlist
evals.prompt: Generate a landscape retrieval pipeline infographic with exactly five numbered nodes and arrows. The only legible strings permitted are exactly "QUERY", "EMBED", "SEARCH", "RERANK", and "ANSWER", each once. Use icons and unlabeled shapes only; do not add explanatory sentences, captions, legends, descriptions, fake UI, logos, or watermark.
expected: Defines the five labels as an explicit allowlist
Forbids explanatory copy under or beside nodes
Checks node count, arrow logic, every readable string, and visual hierarchy
Marks any extra readable text as a critical failure

evals.name: native-alpha-edge-qa
evals.prompt: Generate an isolated translucent glass bottle on a genuinely transparent PNG background. Preserve the glass edges, internal refraction, and label; no checkerboard, solid backdrop, halo, invented shadow, or extra text.
expected: Sets background transparent and output format PNG
Inspects decoded Alpha around glass, reflections, and fine edges
Does not generalize a simple opaque-subject Alpha pass to complex transparency
Rejects a painted checkerboard or solid background

evals.name: workflow-specific-model-selection
evals.prompt: Compare Flare and Sunburst on the same identity-preserving edit with the same prompt, inputs, dimensions, quality, and format. Choose the lowest-latency model only if it meets the same visual acceptance bar.
expected: Changes only the model between paired requests
Records latency, usage, retries, and visual acceptance separately
Does not claim a universal model winner from one workload
Uses Sunburst only when its quality or preservation advantage is necessary
